# `em select pkgconf set`

- **Usage:** `em select pkgconf set [-t --target <TARGET>] <BACKEND>`

Create/update the <target>-pkg-config wrapper

## Arguments
- **`<BACKEND>`** — Backend to wrap (`pkgconf`, `pkg-config`, or a list number from `list`)

## Flags
- **`-t --target <TARGET>`** — Target tuple (CTARGET) to create the wrapper for
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
